messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the p-value? The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard error? Or maybe they want to compute the standard error of the mean? But they mention "以得到人口平均值為98.6" which is the population mean. So likely they want to compute the p-value for a one-sample t-test with null hypothesis population mean = 98.6. They provide sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40. So we need to compute t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / (1.4 / sqrt(40)). Then compute p-value two-tailed? They didn't specify one-tailed or two-tailed. Usually default is two-tailed. So we can compute p-value. Let's do that.

Compute standard error: SE = 1.4 / sqrt(40). sqrt(40) ≈ 6.3249. So SE ≈ 1.4 / 6.3249 ≈ 0.2213. t = (98.2 - 98.6) / 0.2213 = (-0.4) / 0.2213 ≈ -1.807. Degrees of freedom = n-1 = 39. Two-tailed p-value: 2 * P(T <= -1.807). We can approximate using t distribution. For df=39, t=1.807. Using t table: For df=40, t=1.684 gives p=0.10; t=2.021 gives p=0.05. So t=1.807 gives p between 0.05 and 0.10. Roughly p ≈ 0.08. Let's compute more precisely using python? But we can approximate. Let's approximate using t distribution CDF. For df=39, t=1.807. Using approximate formula: p ≈ 0.08. So answer: p-value ~0.08. Alternatively, if one-tailed, p ~0.04. But default two-tailed. So answer: p-value ~0.08. Provide explanation. Also mention standard error. So answer: Standard error = 0.2213, t-statistic = -1.81, p-value ≈ 0.08 (two-tailed). Provide steps.
